requested_outcome: An administrator can clearly and reliably sign out from every admin screen, receives immediate feedback, and cannot recover protected admin content by reloading or using browser history.
authorization_boundary: Diagnose, implement, test and publish the VII admin logout repair under Adir's existing VII publication authorization; do not change administrator membership or authentication providers.

lesson_bundle.reason: The reported failure is a visible production interaction.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires exercising the exact live logout flow rather than relying on source or build evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: Logout is a visible control with success, loading and failure states.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The control must acknowledge activation, prevent duplicate submission and end in a clear result.

lesson_bundle.reason: The admin shell is shared across all admin routes and viewports.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Coverage must include the complete admin route family and mobile presentation, not only catalog sync.

lesson_bundle.reason: The task follows a fresh correction and must remain evidence-backed through delivery.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The correction is attached to the contract and completion is blocked without exact destination evidence.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A server logout route exists but there is still no discoverable control in the admin UI.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Place one labelled logout action in the shared admin command bar.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The action is present on representative desktop and mobile admin routes.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The click appears idle or can be submitted repeatedly.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Add an accessible busy state, disabled duplicate activation and localized progress label.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The button changes to a busy state immediately and issues one POST.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The interface redirects but the authenticated cookie survives.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use the existing server logout endpoint and verify the clearing cookie matches the session cookie path and security attributes.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: After POST, session lookup is unauthenticated and a protected admin request is rejected or redirected.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Browser Back reveals a cached admin page after logout.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Replace the current history entry and revalidate session state when an admin document is restored from browser history.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Back, reload and bfcache restoration do not leave protected admin content usable.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The control disappears on mobile because the desktop navigation footer is hidden.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Put the action in the shared command bar that renders on every viewport.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: At 390px the action remains visible, labelled and keyboard accessible.

sources.label: VII admin shared shell and security requirements

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the shared control, logout request and post-logout navigation are wired, before broad regression and release.
checks: Inspect the rendered shared shell at desktop and mobile widths.
Run focused tests proving one POST, cookie clearing and failure recovery.

attack_questions: Can an administrator navigate to another admin route where logout is missing?
Can a failed logout leave the button permanently disabled or silently redirect?
Can Back, reload or a copied admin URL reveal protected content after logout?
Does the action remain visible and understandable at 390px without colliding with search?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exercise the published logout control on vii.spaplus.co and verify the unauthenticated destination and protected-route behavior.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused auth tests, production build, representative admin route checks and desktop/mobile browser evidence.

effectiveness.baseline: User reports that no usable logout action exists in the admin interface.
effectiveness.target: One shared implementation fixes every admin route with no repeated correction and blocks cached post-logout access.
